patterns.message: Deep imports from @/lib subdirectories are not allowed. Use barrel files (e.g., '@/lib/auth' instead of '@/lib/auth/jwt').
Import from barrel files only (e.g., '@/lib/auth' instead of '@/lib/auth/jwt').
Deep imports from @apex packages are not allowed. Use package-level barrel exports (e.g., '@apex/auth' instead of '@apex/auth/jwt/session').
Invalid LangChain import. Use scoped packages like '@langchain/core', '@langchain/openai', etc. instead of the old 'langchain' package.
Deep imports from LangChain /dist/ folders are not allowed. Use the public API exports (e.g., '@langchain/core/prompts' instead of '@langchain/core/dist/prompts').
Invalid package '@langchain/langchain'. Use specific scoped packages like '@langchain/core', '@langchain/openai', etc.
